# Full Feature Roadmap: Social Battle & Content App (RFP) for BetaTalk

---

## Project Overview

A next-generation social media mobile app inspired by platforms like Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and Snapchat, featuring:
- Short-form video & photo content
- Stories & live streaming
- Live "battle" rooms where creators (artists, influencers) compete
- Token-based betting & prediction markets for battles
- NFT-style badges, smart-contract-based revenue sharing, and real-money betting (where permitted by law)

---

## Project Goals

- Launch MVP: Core social features and basic live battle rooms
- Scale to a feature-rich social, battle, and token-economy platform
- Build a scalable, secure backend for:
    - Live streaming at scale
    - Token-based betting & prediction
    - Blockchain/NFT readiness

---

## High-Level Feature Roadmap

### Phase 1 – MVP (Core Social + Simple Battle)
- Authentication: Sign up/in (email, phone, social); user profiles; friends/followers
- Content & Feeds: Post (text/image/video), follow feed, for-you feed, like/comment/share
- Stories: 24h stories with camera, text, stickers; analytics
- Messaging: 1:1 chat (text/images), group chat (text)
- Live Battle (Lite): 2-person video room, live user voting ("Who's winning?"), badges/points for winners
- Admin: Basic panel for user/content moderation

### Phase 2 – Engagement & Token Economy
- Reels (short-form algorithmic feed)
- Hashtags, categories, Explore page
- Video download (with watermark, opt-in)
- Live Battle + Betting (tokens): In-app tokens, artist pools, prediction pools, auto-payout
- Playlist Battles: Collaborative playlists, voting & visibility
- Time Capsule & Story Bets: Locked posts, friends place token bets
- Monetization: Buy tokens, tipping, ads

### Phase 3 – Blockchain, NFT, Real-Money
- Smart-contract-based revenue sharing (e.g., for viral posts)
- NFT-style badge system & marketplace
- Real-money betting (region-restricted), licensed providers, age verification

---

## Technology Stack

- Frontend: React Native, Flutter, or similar
- Backend: Node.js, Firebase, AWS
- Live/Streaming: WebRTC, Agora, or others
